(2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of various fresh seafood items displayed on crushed ice in a refrigerated display case. These include bright red whole fish, green sea grapes in red trays, and peeled white seafood items. A female hand briefly appears, gesturing toward the fish. (3) A smartphone screen is shown in a close-up, displaying a Google Maps search result for '吳記活海產餐廳' with a 3.9-star rating. The phone is held over a restaurant table setting with small dishes and soy sauce bottles in the background. (4) A rapid sequence of shots shows different prepared dishes being served on a red-clothed table. The dishes include salmon and tuna sashimi, stir-fried noodles, a bowl of soup with chicken testicles, deep-fried oysters with colorful crackers, and a steamed red fish. Yellow text overlays indicate the price for each dish. (5) The man is shown indoors, sitting at a round dining table. He uses chopsticks to lift noodles and pieces of steamed fish to his mouth, tasting them. His facial expressions range from neutral to slightly analytical. The background features white walls with landscape posters and other diners. (6) A handheld shot focuses on a handwritten white order bill from '吳海產餐飲部' with various blue-ink entries and prices, showing a final total of 3,460. (7) The man returns to the original outdoor street setting, standing in front of the same seafood restaurant sign. He continues his monologue toward the camera, speaking with expressive facial movements before the video ends.
